name: Georgia Byron
source:
Based on Lord Byron.

A general nuisance who derives great pleasure from making other people (particularly Roberta) unhappy.  She says all kinds of outrageous things she doesn’t truly believe just to offend other people, so it’s often difficult to tell what she really thinks.  She is a genuine lady, coming from a well-connected family, and takes great pride in this fact. Sadly, her title is nothing more than mere decoration, as her family is almost destitute.
